day_summary: NIGHT UPDATE — STOP DAY 1 ACTIVE; RUSSELL RECONSTITUTION FAILED; NVDA CLOSED $192.53 (−2.20%); RECORD $334B NASDAQ CLOSING CROSS ABSORBED BY ACTIVE SELLING. NVDA opened June 26 at $202.17 on Russell Reconstitution NVDA #1 gap-up enthusiasm, then sold off steadily throughout the session to close at $192.53 (−$4.34, −2.20% from the June 25 close of $196.87). The record $334.027B Nasdaq closing cross — executed in 1.63 seconds, the largest passive Growth ETF reconstitution flow event in Nasdaq closing-cross history — was COMPLETELY ABSORBED by active institutional selling without producing a net positive close. MU fell −2.1%, AMD −2.6%, WDC −10.52% on the same session. STOP DAY 1 ACTIVATED: the June 26 close ($192.53) is below the $195 two-close stop threshold. One additional close below $195 on June 29 (next US session) triggers the full exit. Regime gates: SPX 7,354.02 (−5 pts from June 25; 106 pts below 7,460 floor), VIX 18.89 (above 17 gate), DXY 101.25 (above 100 gate) — all three remain breached. Russell 2000 +0.71% (small-caps outperformed as reconstitution flows boosted smaller names while mega-cap Growth sold off). NFP June report pulled forward to Thursday July 2 (markets closed July 3, Independence Day observed) with consensus +172K is the next binary macro event. The reconstitution failure is the most bearish technical signal of the current regime: if $334B in passive NVDA buying produces a LOWER close than the prior session, the active institutional selling overhang is structurally larger than any foreseeable passive buying program. Do NOT add. Hold core position with stop framework on Day 1 countdown. Q2 FY27 earnings (~late August, ~$91B) remains the structural catalyst and the next genuine add window.

analysis:
## Technical analysis (post-close, June 26)

**Session recap:** Opened $202.17 (Russell Reconstitution gap-up), then sold off steadily to close $192.53. Range: $191–$202.17. Record $334.027B Nasdaq closing cross at 4 PM ET executed in 1.63 seconds — absorbed entirely by active institutional selling.

**Stop Day 1 activated:** $195 two-close stop breached on June 26 close ($192.53 < $195). Two-close requirement means June 29 is the deciding session: close above $195 = stop reset; close below $195 = full exit.

**Reconstitution failure signal:** The session high ($202.17 open) is now a confirmed distribution ceiling — active sellers absorbed every reconstitution bid at a price ABOVE prior support. This is a supply-dominance signal that overrides the passive demand narrative. Compare to BTC's declining daily session highs: NVDA showed the same staircase distribution pattern on the single highest-liquidity day of the year.

**Regime:** SPX 7,354 (−106 pts below floor), VIX 18.89 (above gate), DXY 101.25 (above gate). Fifth consecutive session with all three gates breached. No add until all three clear simultaneously.

**Next session setup (June 29):** Oil Brent −4.34% is a positive (removes Hormuz inflation premium). NFP July 2 creates binary risk. The stop Day 1 countdown and NFP binary together make June 29 the most consequential NVDA session between the reconstitution and Q2 earnings.
